title: Jammy Chinese Pork Buddha Jumps Over Wall
description: A traditional Chinese dish featuring pork belly, wrapped in lotus leaf and steamed to perfection, with a sweet and sour jammy sauce made with malt vinegar, perfect for a post-workout meal. This dish is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and serves as a great source of energy.
instructions: Preheat the steamer to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small saucepan, combine malt vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, or until it thickens and turns jammy.
Season the pork belly with salt and pepper, then wrap it in lotus leaves, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the wrapped pork belly in the steamer, and steam for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and easily shreds with a fork.
While the pork is steaming, heat the sesame oil in a small pan over medium heat, and saute the sliced ginger and minced garlic until fragrant.
Once the pork is cooked, remove it from the steamer, and brush it with the jammy sauce and the ginger-garlic oil.
Serve the pork belly hot, garnished with sliced scallions and steamed bok choy.
To make the dish more substantial, serve with steamed rice or noodles.
